reached_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT customer.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
           customer.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
           date_dim.d_date AS d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, 's' AS channel
        FROM store_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, 'c' AS channel
        FROM catalog_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, 'w' AS channel
        FROM web_sales
    ) AS sales
    JOIN date_dim ON sales.date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON sales.customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
    GROUP BY customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sales.channel) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
